title: Ôn luyện Từ vựng thi vào 10 số 52: Vietnamese lifestyle: Then and Now (Set 1)

lessons.contentHtml:
Hãy cùng học các từ vựng thuộc chủ điểm Vietnamese lifestyle: Then and Now (Set 1) ngay nhé!


Nhấn ᐸ / ᐳ để chuyển sang từ khác và 🔊 để nghe phát âm.

Bạn nên đọc kĩ nghĩa, ví dụ và nghe phát âm của tất cả các từ vựng trước khi nhấn "Next" để chuyển sang luyện tập ở mức nhận biết.

Hãy cùng luyện tập các từ vựng bạn vừa học nhé!

(Nhấn "Next" để chuyển sang các bài tập tiếp theo.)

vocabTable.meaning: từ vựng thuộc bài Then and Now (Set 1)
vocabTable.example: Drag and drop to complete the text. Nowadays, life in Vietnam is very 18.1 from the past. Young people have a better chance to learn with modern schools, online resources, and 18.2 for their future careers. Many teenagers are less 18.3 on parents and make their own decisions about education and lifestyle. Some express themselves by the way they choose their own clothes or even 18.4 their hair in bright colors. Despite these changes, Vietnamese culture still reflects strong  18.5 . Parents 18.6 their children, and traditional festivals like Tet remain important. Modern life brings new opportunities, but family love and respect continue to be the foundation of Vietnamese society.

vocabTable.example: Complete the conversation. Lan: Grandma, how was family life in the past? Grandma: It was very different, Lan. Families were big, and we lived in a(n) 17.1 extended family nuclear family with grandparents, parents, and children in one 17.2 course household . Lan: Was the 17.3 parents-children relation community service  strict? Grandma: Yes, children respected their parents and obeyed them. Parents worked hard to provide for the family, and children helped with housework and farming. Lan: Did you play a lot? Grandma: We played simple games like marbles and kite flying, but we also had duties. Some boys even 17.4 drove rode buffalos in the fields.
